adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `AdminGroupRoute.setupController` from returning/chaining `findMembers()` in `afterModel` to calling `model.findMembers();` without returning/handling the promise (`app/assets/javascripts/admin/routes/admin_group_route.js`). `Discourse.Group#findMembers` now performs an AJAX request and only has a `.then(...)` with no error handling (`app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`). With the promise no longer returned from a route hook, a rejection won’t trigger Ember’s normal route error handling and `members` won’t be updated (it’s only set inside the `.then`), leaving the UI in an empty/stale state on failure with no in-code mechanism to surface the error.
